thread:
Sam Rivera: hey team :wave: I'm starting oncall this week — tried to accept the PagerDuty invite but couldn't access the runbook repo or get the staging pager test to work. Anyone available to help quick?
Alex Chen: welcome Sam! check the onboarding checklist: https://internal.redwood.com/oncall/onboarding. For PagerDuty: accept the invite, then run the PD test from the CLI. Also make sure your Okta groups include `oncall-rotation`.
Jasmin Patel: I can re-send the PD invite from my side. Sam, what's the email associated with your PagerDuty account?
Sam Rivera: sam.rivera@redwood.com
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty invite resent to sam.rivera@redwood.com — click the link to join the rotation. :white_check_mark:
Alex Chen: for runbook access, file the "Request Runbook Access" form on Confluence under Oncall -> Access, or DM me and I'll grant read perms if it's urgent.
Sam Rivera: thanks! I tried the pager test but the alert didn't route to me — also seeing a permission denied when hitting the k8s namespace for runbook-staging.
Kyle Morgan: likely RBAC. Run `kubectl auth can-i get pods --namespace runbook-staging` and paste the output here.
Sam Rivera: output: "error: You can't list resources in the namespace \"runbook-staging\"." — thanks for the pointer, pinging kyle for grant.
Kyle Morgan: granted `view` role in `runbook-staging` to your account. Try the `kubectl` command again and then trigger the PD test: ```
# trigger our test alert
redwood-cli alert trigger --service runbook-staging --type test
```
Sam Rivera: verified — test alert came through and I received the PagerDuty notification. Also saw the shadow training invite in calendar. When's the live triage session?
Jasmin Patel: shadow session is Thursday 10:00am PT — Zoom link is in the calendar invite. We'll pair you with a senior oncall for the first pager wave.
Alex Chen: quick incident cheat-sheet (short): 1) Acknowledge in PagerDuty, 2) run `runbook lookup <service>`, 3) post a short summary to #incidents with current status and actions, 4) escalate to the next oncall if you've been >15m with no fix. We'll be updating the runbooks this week with concrete commands and examples.
Sam Rivera: perfect, that's helpful — appreciate the quick responses :pray:
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete the "Oncall Basics" lab in the Learning Portal by Friday to get full rotation privileges.
